Name: 5 signs your furnace needs replacing
Post Body:
A furnace usually lasts 15–20 years. Here is how to tell it is time for a new one.

1. Age over 15 years

Older units lose efficiency every season, and parts get harder to find.

2. Rising energy bills

If your bills climb while your usage stays the same, the system is working harder than it should.

3. Frequent repairs

When a repair costs more than half the price of a new unit, replacement is usually the smarter choice.

4. Uneven heating

Cold rooms and hot spots point to a worn blower or failing components.

5. Strange noises or smells

Banging, rattling or a burning smell is a reason to call a technician right away.
Post Summary: How to tell when repairing your old furnace no longer makes sense.

Name: Getting your AC ready for summer
Post Body:
A short checklist to make sure your air conditioner doesn't quit on the hottest day of the year.

  • Replace the air filter.
  • Clear leaves and debris from around the outdoor unit.
  • Check that the condensate drain is clear.
  • Schedule seasonal maintenance with a technician.
